metadata.scope: Closure decision using complete finding lifecycle evidence after remediation, targeted verification, and related-path verification.

summary.closure_decision: 10 findings are approved for closure. TF-008 is not approved for final closure until the related-path regression candidate TF-008-R1 is remediated or explicitly accepted.

lifecycle_inputs_used: Scan Report-1 repository intelligence and architecture context

closure_results.title: Unauthenticated Python eval code execution
closure_results.original_condition: Unauthenticated /evaluate input reached Python eval and could execute arbitrary code.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: The route uses safe_eval_expression and only permits arithmetic AST nodes.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-001 and MAINPY-001 as duplicates of TF-001.
Priority ranked TF-001 as immediate attention.
Remediation replaced eval with constrained AST evaluation.
Targeted verification rejected __import__("os").system("id") and preserved arithmetic.
Related-path verification rejected calls, imports, attribute access, and comprehension bypasses.
closure_results.security_improvement: Untrusted expression input no longer crosses into Python code execution.

closure_results.title: OS command injection in DNS lookup
closure_results.original_condition: Unauthenticated /lookup input was concatenated into an os.popen shell command.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Shell execution is disabled and lookup uses validated socket-based DNS resolution.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-002 and MAINPY-002 as duplicates of TF-002.
Priority ranked TF-002 as immediate attention.
Remediation disabled rp shell execution and added dns_lookup validation.
Targeted verification found no popen and rejected shell metacharacter input.
Related-path verification rejected ;, &&, backticks, $(), and | variants before DNS resolution.
closure_results.security_improvement: User-controlled hostnames no longer reach a shell command boundary.

closure_results.title: Pickle deserialization of client cookie
closure_results.original_condition: The client-controlled value cookie was base64-decoded and passed to pickle.loads.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Cookie state uses HMAC-signed JSON and invalid or legacy values are rejected.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-003 and MAINPY-003 as duplicates of TF-003.
Priority ranked TF-003 as immediate attention.
Remediation replaced pickle cookie state with signed JSON.
Targeted verification rejected a base64 pickle cookie.
Related-path verification rejected unsigned JSON, tampered signed values, and legacy pickle-like cookies.
closure_results.security_improvement: Client cookies are authenticated data and no longer become Python objects.

closure_results.title: Server-side template injection in greeting route
closure_results.original_condition: The name parameter was interpolated into Jinja template source before rendering.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: The template source is fixed and name is passed as a template variable.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-004 and MAINPY-004 as duplicates of TF-004.
Priority ranked TF-004 as immediate attention.
Remediation changed /sayhi to static template plus variable binding.
Targeted verification observed {{7*7}} rendered literally.
Related-path verification found {{config}}, control-block, and os.popen template payloads inert.
closure_results.security_improvement: User input is rendered as escaped data instead of compiled template code.

closure_results.title: SQL injection in listservices category filter
closure_results.original_condition: The category parameter was interpolated directly into the service-listing SQL WHERE clause.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: The request-driven service query uses DB-API parameters and backend-appropriate placeholders.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-005 and MAINPY-005 as duplicates of TF-005.
Priority placed TF-005 in near-term remediation.
Remediation parameterized /listservices category filtering.
Targeted verification confirmed normal filtering and blocked UNION secret extraction.
Related-path verification blocked UNION, OR, and stacked-query variants; public_stuff remained intact.
closure_results.security_improvement: User category values are bound as data rather than SQL syntax.
closure_results.residual_note: Runtime verification used sqlite; non-sqlite placeholder behavior was statically reviewed.

closure_results.title: JWT algorithm confusion and None acceptance
closure_results.original_condition: Attacker-controlled JWT alg headers could select None or HS256 verification paths.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: JWT verification is pinned to RS256 and HS256/None helper paths are absent.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-006 and MAINPY-006 as duplicates of TF-006.
Priority placed TF-006 in near-term remediation.
Remediation set ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS to RS256 and removed weaker verifier paths.
Targeted verification rejected an alg None admin token and accepted a valid RS256 guest login.
Related-path verification rejected HS256 and unsigned admin tokens; JWKS advertises RS256 only.
closure_results.security_improvement: JWT trust decisions no longer depend on attacker-selected algorithm headers.

closure_results.title: Unsafe XML parser configuration
closure_results.original_condition: Unauthenticated XML input was parsed with DTD loading, entity resolution, network access, and huge_tree behavior enabled.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: The XML parser disables DTD loading, network access, entity resolution, validation, and huge_tree.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-007 and MAINPY-007 as duplicates of TF-007.
Priority placed TF-007 in near-term remediation.
Remediation hardened lxml XMLParser settings.
Targeted verification showed a file:// XXE payload was not resolved.
Related-path verification found file and external SYSTEM payloads did not disclose external content.
closure_results.security_improvement: Untrusted XML no longer crosses the parser resource/entity trust boundary.

closure_results.title: AES-CBC config selector padding/decryption oracle
closure_results.original_condition: GET /config?key accepted attacker-supplied AES-CBC ciphertext and exposed distinguishable decrypt/unpad behavior.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Config selectors are HMAC-signed JSON tokens and malformed selectors fail generically, but a signed token for an unviewable key raises a TypeError instead of generic invalid-key handling.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-008 and MAINPY-010 as duplicates of TF-008.
Priority placed TF-008 in planned remediation.
Remediation replaced AES-CBC selector ciphertext with HMAC-signed selector tokens and generic malformed-token errors.
Targeted verification confirmed tampered selector generic failure and valid visible selector behavior.
Related-path verification identified TF-008-R1: signed secret_admin_value selector raises TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "NoneType") to str.
closure_results.security_improvement: The original padding/decryption oracle and unauthenticated chosen-ciphertext path are broken.
closure_results.required_rework: Before closure, /config should return a generic invalid-key response whenever read_config_token returns a key outside the viewable allowlist, before building the config-value HTML.
closure_results.closure_blocker: Related-path regression candidate TF-008-R1 prevents final closure even though no secret disclosure was observed and no external signing route was identified.

closure_results.title: Raw HTML rendering of attacker-influenced values
closure_results.original_condition: Multiple routes concatenated attacker-influenced values into HTML without consistent output encoding.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Dynamic values are escaped or rendered through Jinja variable escaping, and sensitive errors are generic.
closure_evidence: Triage consolidated BF-009 and MAINPY-008, preserving expanded /listservices evidence.
Priority placed TF-009 in planned remediation.
Remediation escaped cookie/user/database output and stopped reflecting raw exceptions.
Targeted verification confirmed script cookie output was escaped.
Related-path verification confirmed cookie, evaluate, user, and service output paths did not render executable markup.
closure_results.security_improvement: Attacker-controlled text is rendered as text rather than executable browser content.

closure_results.title: Predictable temporary JWT private key storage
closure_results.original_condition: Fallback JWT key generation wrote private/public keys to predictable temporary paths and printed paths.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Fallback key material is generated and retained in memory only.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-010 and MAINPY-009 as duplicates of TF-010.
Priority placed TF-010 in planned remediation.
Remediation removed predictable temp key file writes and path printing.
Targeted verification found no private.pem or public.pem references.
Related-path verification confirmed fallback SIGN_KEY and VERIFY_KEY are bytes in memory.
closure_results.security_improvement: Default startup no longer exposes generated JWT signing key material through temp files or logs.

closure_results.title: Authentication cookie missing Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite
closure_results.original_condition: Authentication cookies were set without security attributes.
closure_results.post_remediation_state: Value and auth cookies set HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure when request.is_secure is true.
closure_evidence: Triage confirmed BF-011 and MAINPY-011 as duplicates of TF-011.
Priority placed TF-011 in planned remediation.
Remediation added HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and conditional Secure.
Targeted verification confirmed HttpOnly on value and auth cookies.
Related-path verification confirmed HTTP cookies include HttpOnly/SameSite and HTTPS-context cookies include Secure.
closure_results.security_improvement: Bearer token exposure through browser script access and cross-site contexts is reduced.
closure_results.residual_note: Secure depends on HTTPS request context; production must preserve request.is_secure correctly.
